LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightModeCommandOnDesc:
This Rukaya takes off on being drafted and stays airborne until this switch is turned off or she is undrafted.

She ignores this switch while engaging an enemy target and will take off regardless.

Requires at least one wing intact and at least 10% satiety.
LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightModeCommandOffDesc:
This Rukaya stays on the ground while drafted.

She still takes off while engaging an enemy target, and lands again once the fight is over, returning to this switch's state.

Undrafting switches flight back off.
LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightDisabledNoWings: Both wings must be intact to fly.
LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightDisabledHungry: Satiety must be at least {0}% to fly.
